composition_subtypes.role: Process tracks in descending coolness order to simulate maximum updates
Maintain processed indices to find next larger element and propagate answer

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort descending coolness, then use BIT to track active indices for answer propagation; RMQ binary search finds stopping point.
payload.rationale: Combines sorting and Fenwick tree; RMQ-based binary search is also key but not in candidate subtypes, lowering confidence.
